reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was 30 individual foil sachets, which is a lot of single-use packaging for something I take every day, and then that there are zero reviews, so I have nothing to read. objection: A foil packet for every single day is wasteful, and with no reviews I cannot check that it works or that people tolerate it.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred honest reviews, a bottle or refill option without the foil sachets, and a Subscribe & Save price that is clearly lower per serving.
